name: io.github.crajah/post-graph-rag-mcp
title: post-graph-rag-mcp
description: Bi-temporal Graph RAG memory on PostgreSQL + pgvector that retires superseded facts.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_URI
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection URI (pgvector required). Omit when using [embedded] on Python 3.12.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_REALM
environmentVariables.description: Tenant/project graph namespace. Auto-derived from git repository root when unset.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for an OpenAI-compatible router (enables autonomous LLM extraction).

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional base URL for an OpenAI-compatible router (vLLM, LiteLLM, OpenRouter, Ollama).
